name: Terminal Agent Hero
description: A dark split hero for a dev tool: confident copy and a copyable install chip beside a terminal where an agent plans, writes files, passes tests and opens a PR.
usage:
import { HeroTerminalAgent } from "@/components/design-for-ai/hero-terminal-agent";

<HeroTerminalAgent
  brand="Northwind CLI"
  headline="Ship the change, skip the chores."
  emphasis="skip the chores."
  installCommand="npx northwind@latest init"
/>

props.name: emphasis
props.description: Substring of the headline set at 45% opacity.

props.name: facts
props.description: Short mono facts under the actions.

props.name: session
props.description: The terminal script: command, plan, files, tests and PR.

props.name: loopPause
props.description: Milliseconds the finished session stays before replaying.
